chapter.verse: Khris Jesu' nasemte ahi keimah Paul leh Timothy in Philippi khua-a om pawlpi syate leh upate-a kipan Khris Jesu sunga mi siangthote khempeuh kong hopih uh hi.
Note' tungah hehpihna hong tung henla i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
Note kong phawk simin ka Pasian' tungah lungdam ka ko hi.
Na vekpi uh' ading ka thungette khempeuh lungdamna tawh ka nget det ahi hi.
A hang pen Lungdamna Thu tangkona vai ah a ni masapen pan tu ciangdong kei nong kithuahpih uh hi.
Tua hi a, ka telciat thu ahihleh note' sungah nahoih sepna hong pankhiapa in Jesu Khris' ni dong ah tua nasep hong zawhpihsuak ding hi.

Note khempeuh tawh kisai-in hih bang lungsim ka neih pen a kilawm thu ahi hi. A hang pen kolbulh khaukhih ka thuakna ah hitaleh, Lungdamna Thu hutna dalna leh kipsakna ah hitaleh Pasian' hehpihna hangin na vekun kei tawh hong pangkhawm na hih manun note ka lungtang sungah na om uh hi.
A hang pen Khris Jesu' lainatna tawh na vekun kong phawkzia, Pasian ka teci ahi hi.
Theihna cingtaak leh khentel theihna citeng tawh na itna uh a dimlet semsem ahih ding ka thungetna ahi hi.
Tua hileh a hoihpen bang hiam cih na khentel thei ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin Khris ni' ading a siangtho, a paubaanglo dingin om unla
Pasian' tungah minpha leh phatna a om nadingin Jesu Khris' tungtawna hong pai diktatna gah tawh na kidim un.
Sanggamte aw, kei' tunga hong piang thute in Lungdamna Thu masotna piangsak taktak ahihlam kong theisak nuam hi.
Kolbulh khaukhih ka thuak pen Khris' ading ahihlam mang innpi a cing galkapte leh a dang teng khempeuh in thei khinta uh hi.
Sanggamte zong kolbulh khaukhih ka thuakna hangin a tamzaw Topa' sungah sunglam kimuanna hong nei uh a, lau lo takin thu genkhia ngamzaw tham uh hi.
Tua lakah hazatna leh demnopna tawh Khris' thu a tangko zong kimkhat om a, ahih hangin a dangte ahihleh deihsakna tak tawh ahi uh hi.
Amaute in Lungdamna Thu a hu a dal dingin hih takah kei hong kikoih ahihlam thei uh ahih manin itna tawh genkhia uh hi.
A masa pawl ahihleh lungsim siangtho tawh hilo-in kolbulh khaukhih ka thuakna ah ka gim nading ngaihsunin angsung khualna tawh Khris' thu a pulak uh ahi hi.

Tua ahihleh bangci dan ding ahi hiam? Kineihna tawh ahi-a thutak tawh ahi zongin bangci nam tawh hitaleh Khris' thu kigenkhia ahihna thu hang bekbek tawh kei ka lungdam hi. Himah hi, kei ka lungdamto lai ding hi.
A hang pen nong thungetsaknate uh leh Jesu Khris' Kha ii thadipna tungtawnin hih thu keima' suahtakna hong suak ding cih ka thei hi.

Maizumhuai bangmah tuakkha lo ding cih thu leh hanna tawh kidim den ka hih mah bangin tu-in zong nuntakna tawh ahi-a sihna tawh ahi zongin keima' pumpi tungtawnin Khris kipahtawi ding cih thu pen ka ngaklah leh ka lamet thu ahi hi.
A hang pen ka nuntakleh Khris' ading, ka sihleh hamphatna ka ci hi.
Tu-in pumpi tawh a nungtasuak ding ka hihleh tua pen kei' adingin gahleteh a nei nasepna hiding a, ahi zongin ka deihzawk ka gen thei naikei hi.
Thu nih kikal ah ka awkcip hi. Ka lunggulh ahihleh leitung nusia-in Khris tawh omkhop ding hi a, tua pen kei' ading hoihzaw tham hi.
Ahih hangin note' hangin pumpi mah tawh ka omzom ding kisamzaw hi.
Hih thu telcian ka hih manin upna sungah khantohna leh lungdamna na neih nadingun kei hong omzomin na vekun hong ompih ding ka hihlam ka thei hi.
Tua hileh note' kiangah kong paikikna tawh keima' hangin Khris Jesu' sungah na kisialhpih ding uh tampi hong kibehlap ding hi.

Note tawh kimu dingin kong pai thei-a kong pai theikei zongin note Kha khat sungah dingkipin Lungdamna Thu tawh kipawl upna thu ah lungsim kikhatin hanciamkhawm diamdiam cih thu ka zak theih nadingin Khris' Lungdamna Thu tawh a kituak nam bekin na gamta un.
Na langte uh hangin bangmah thu ah lau kei un. Tua bang hileh amau' adingin kisiatna tung ding cihna lim hi a, note' ading ahihleh hotkhiatna lim, Pasian' kiangpan hong pai lim ahi hi.
A hang pen Khris a um ding bek hilo-in ama' ading gimthuak dingin zong Khrih' taangin note hong kiseh khinzo hi.
Tua hangin zong thu haksa ka tuahkhak hong mu na hi uh a, tu-in zong tua mah buaipih lai ka hihlam a zakha na hi uh hi.
